correctness.rationale: For the declared positive, global truth-functional Boolean connectives and primitive pattern-existence inclusion atoms of arity <=r<k, formula truth is determined exactly by the family of r-coordinate projections: induction on connectives and atoms and conversely a differentiating atom. The natural join closure C_r(T) is idempotent, profile-preserving, and largest among all teams in its class. Every |T|<=r is closed by selecting one coordinate of disagreement with a target per row and extending to r coordinates. If |T|=r+1, the missing valuation v is invisible iff its r+1 nonempty difference supports are pairwise disjoint (hitting number >r); any two meeting supports give an r-point transversal. For r>=2, a v-versus-w differing coordinate rules out two invisible valuations. Disjoint-support partitions into r+1 nonempty marked/nonmarked blocks give exactly 2^k (S(k,r+1)+(r+2)S(k,r+2)) ordered (T,v) pairs; for r>=2 they correspond bijectively to nonclosed minimal teams. Independent exhaustive Boolean-team and projection computations for k=3,4, r<k agree with thresholds, 160 at (4,2), 16 at (4,3), disjoint supports and uniqueness.
residual_risks: Only literal constant/variable primitive atoms, no splitting disjunction, negation or general inclusion atoms; r=1 cannot claim a unique invisible point. Finite experiments do not replace general hitting-set proof.
